answer.rationale: Primary contract expiry plus a no-buffer 94% line makes deferral and an unbuffered primary switch both delivery-risk increasing. Incumbent continuity has previously avoided migration interruption (c1). The low-cost quote meets the 18% mandate and last year's switch was operationally smooth on onboarding/invoicing (c2), but that record does not establish delivery performance under today's zero-buffer load, so switching would raise delivery risk versus the objective. Benchmarked renewal negotiation has previously moved the incumbent on price and terms (c4); use the competing quote as leverage to pursue the spend cut while keeping the integrated source. Uncertain whether incumbent will fully match 18%.
